description: Ten short fixed prompts. Run non-streaming at temperature 0, reasoning_effort low (the same setting the measured traffic uses) and max_tokens 64 before every experiment. The comparison is on the first 16 whitespace-separated words of the visible content - not on tokenizer tokens, because both sides have to be able to reproduce it by hand. A candidate needs at least 8 of 10 prefixes to match the baseline file; an errored or empty reply is a mismatch. Fewer than 8 means the weights, chat template or sampling changed and the run is not comparable, whatever the latency says. The baseline file itself is only written when all 10 prompts returned real, non-empty content.
